lunch.name: Ceviche (Raw Fish in Citrus)
lunch.description: Peru's national lunch dish - raw fish cured in lime juice. Preparation technique dates back to Incan times
instructions: Combine lime juice, orange juice and salt in bowl
Add fish cubes and sliced onion, mix gently
Refrigerate 15-30 minutes - fish will become opaque and firm from acid
Serve immediately with boiled sweet potato and corn on side
lunch.notes: Fish must be sushi-grade/very fresh. Citrus juice cooks fish through chemical process
lunch.fun_fact: Ceviche is Peru's national lunch dish, preparation technique dates back to Incan times when fish was cured in chicha (corn beer)
alternatives: Make with coconut milk (leche de tigre)

dinner.name: Peruvian Ceviche (Raw Fish Cured in Lime Juice with Leche de Tigre)
dinner.description: Raw fish cured in lime juice with leche de tigre - Peruvian dinner specialty
ingredients: 600g white fish fillets (sea bass, sole, red snapper), cut into 2cm cubes
200g fish trimmings or extra white fish
1 fresh red chili or aji amarillo
1 red onion, sliced into thin julienne
2 fresh red chilies or aji amarillos, sliced
Salt and white pepper to taste
2 corn cobs (choclo), cooked and cut into rounds
instructions: Prepare leche de tigre: blend fish trimmings, red onion, garlic, ginger, chili, cilantro stems with ice
Pass through fine sieve, pressing to extract all liquid
Measure out 250ml leche de tigre; reserve extra
Soak red onion slices in salt and vinegar water for 30 minutes
Place fish cubes in shallow ceramic or glass bowl (not metal)
Pour leche de tigre over fish; stir gently
Let sit 5-10 minutes only (do not over-marinate)
Taste fish; should be just cooked through by lime acid
Drain excess liquid if too much accumulated
Add drained red onion, fresh cilantro, fresh chili, salt, pepper
Serve with sweet potato and corn on the side
dinner.notes: Must use very fresh fish prepared same day
dinner.fun_fact: Lime juice 'cooks' fish through protein denaturation
